summary: Frontend-only verification of the SpiderRunner on /cementerio. Logged in via /api/auth/demo, injected primal_token, and polled [data-testid='cemetery-spider'] every 500ms for 13s. Spider stayed invisible (opacity 0, transform matrix(1,0,0,1,-80,-80)) until ~7s, then opacity rose to 1 and translate(x,y) changed continuously across 11 samples along a straight diagonal path (x: 1510→-70, y: 670→285), consistent with an edge-to-edge ↖ route. Rotation matrix stayed constant during travel (spider faces travel direction). At ~12.5s it faded back to opacity 0. Computed style confirms position:fixed, z-index:60, pointer-events:none. Cemetery cards remained clickable — clicking a card opened [data-testid='cemetery-profile-modal']. [data-testid='cemetery-vine-canopy'] regression OK. No console/page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: SpiderRunner.jsx: the 'never repeat previous direction' guard only bumps idx by +1 when equal — with 8 routes this works but if lastIdx==-1 initially there is no prior comparison (fine, but note the -1 sentinel means the first run truly is random). No functional issue.
The Math.random() index selection has slight non-uniformity after the collision bump (idx becomes (idx+1)%8), which biases the neighbor route slightly higher; acceptable for cosmetic effect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Spider first run at ~8s, ~4s crossing. Poll opacity + transform for 13s to catch it. Verified diagonal ↖ this run; direction is randomized per code review (buildRoutes returns 8 routes; picks random != previous). Cards clickable through the fixed pointer-events-none overlay. Vine canopy present (data-testid='cemetery-vine-canopy'). Profile modal opens on card click.
rca of the issue: No issue — feature works as specified.
